sources.fullCitation: Jan Kiepura with the Odeon-Künstler-Orchester under Dr. Weissmann. “Ninon”, the song from the sound film Ein Lied für dich; music by Walter Jurmann and Dr. Bronislaw Kaper, words by Fritz Rotter and Ernst Marischka. Odeon red label, 1933. The upload gives no catalogue number and does not show the disc. Published on YouTube by 78Upm. Accessed 20 August 2026.
